record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Prayer<WH08605> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Bow down<WH05186><WTH8685> thine ear<WH0241>, O LORD<WH03068>, hear<WH06030><WTH8798> me: for I <FI>am<Fi> poor<WH06041> and needy<WH034>. <RF>A Prayer...: or, A Prayer, being a Psalm of David<Rf>

Preserve<WH08104><WTH8798> my soul<WH05315>; for I <FI>am<Fi> holy<WH02623>: O thou my God<WH0430>, save<WH03467><WTH8685> thy servant<WH05650> that trusteth<WH0982><WTH8802> in thee. <RF>holy: or, one whom thou favourest<Rf>
Be merciful<WH02603><WTH8798> unto me, O Lord<WH0136>: for I cry<WH07121><WTH8799> unto thee daily<WH03117>. <RF>daily: or, all the day<Rf>
Rejoice<WH08055><WTH8761> the soul<WH05315> of thy servant<WH05650>: for unto thee, O Lord<WH0136>, do I lift up<WH05375><WTH8799> my soul<WH05315>.
For thou, Lord<WH0136>, <FI>art<Fi> good<WH02896>, and ready to forgive<WH05546>; and plenteous<WH07227> in mercy<WH02617> unto all them that call<WH07121><WTH8802> upon thee.
Give ear<WH0238><WTH8685>, O LORD<WH03068>, unto my prayer<WH08605>; and attend<WH07181><WTH8685> to the voice<WH06963> of my supplications<WH08469>.
In the day<WH03117> of my trouble<WH06869> I will call<WH07121><WTH8799> upon thee: for thou wilt answer<WH06030><WTH8799> me.<CM>
Among the gods<WH0430> <FI>there is<Fi> none like unto thee, O Lord<WH0136>; neither <FI>are there any works<Fi> like unto thy works<WH04639>.

All nations<WH01471> whom thou hast made<WH06213><WTH8804> shall come<WH0935><WTH8799> and worship<WH07812><WTH8691> before<WH06440> thee, O Lord<WH0136>; and shall glorify<WH03513><WTH8762> thy name<WH08034>.
For thou <FI>art<Fi> great<WH01419>, and doest<WH06213><WTH8802> wondrous things<WH06381><WTH8737>: thou <FI>art<Fi> God<WH0430> alone.

Teach<WH03384><WTH8685> me thy way<WH01870>, O LORD<WH03068>; I will walk<WH01980><WTH8762> in thy truth<WH0571>: unite<WH03161><WTH8761> my heart<WH03824> to fear<WH03372><WTH8800> thy name<WH08034>.
I will praise<WH03034><WTH8686> thee, O Lord<WH0136> my God<WH0430>, with all my heart<WH03824>: and I will glorify<WH03513><WTH8762> thy name<WH08034> for evermore<WH05769>.
For great<WH01419> <FI>is<Fi> thy mercy<WH02617> toward me: and thou hast delivered<WH05337><WTH8689> my soul<WH05315> from the lowest<WH08482> hell<WH07585>. <RF>hell: or, grave<Rf>

O God<WH0430>, the proud<WH02086> are risen<WH06965><WTH8804> against me, and the assemblies<WH05712> of violent<WH06184> <FI>men<Fi> have sought<WH01245><WTH8765> after my soul<WH05315>; and have not set<WH07760><WTH8804> thee before them. <RF>violent: Heb. terrible<Rf>
But thou, O Lord<WH0136>, <FI>art<Fi> a God<WH0410> full of compassion<WH07349>, and gracious<WH02587>, longsuffering<WH0750><WH0639>, and plenteous<WH07227> in mercy<WH02617> and truth<WH0571>.

O turn<WH06437><WTH8798> unto me, and have mercy<WH02603><WTH8798> upon me; give<WH05414><WTH8798> thy strength<WH05797> unto thy servant<WH05650>, and save<WH03467><WTH8685> the son<WH01121> of thine handmaid<WH0519>.

Shew<WH06213><WTH8798> me a token<WH0226> for good<WH02896>; that they which hate<WH08130><WTH8802> me may see<WH07200><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> , and be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799>: because thou, LORD<WH03068>, hast holpen<WH05826><WTH8804> me, and comforted<WH05162><WTH8765> me.<CM>
